fractional: Prediction maximum strictly below1-1e-9; concentrated numerical predictions are not mathematical certainty
training_information: Only complete public raw streams and generator groups, without owner parameters or family labels passed to fitting; all candidates share training and validation data
fitting: Three ordinary sequence classes: empirical transition particles, exact exchangeable Dirichlet mixture, unrestricted row-Dirichlet mixture;40EM iterations fit class prior on public validation likelihood, then reserve10percent prior for broad row-Dirichlet. Best static candidate selected by same validation mean log likelihood
runtime: Raw public prefix, mask, complete raw alias bridges, raw alias query and price only; no owner family, generator parameters, targets or runtime family oracle
schedule: Four initial keys permuted, then two overwrite keys drawn from generator q distinct-or-independent mixture; six WRITEs randomly interleaved with8or24distractors;2/3/4uniformcontent-independentmissingpositions
families: IID pi~Dirichlet(.4);sticky previous with rho Uniform(.6,.97) else pi;rotor forward or backward with rho else pi; all have q Uniform. Switching rotor flips direction at WRITE index3;pair-renewal holds each value for two consecutive WRITEs. Last two processes appear only in locked confirmation
guard: Separate OOD calibration per trained family. Runtime model-specific surprise cutoff=max family.99higher quantiles; broad-component posterior cutoff=max family.99higher quantiles. Same cutoffs apply family-blind. ActualREAD recomputes broad posterior and rechecks guard; READ expected branch payoff includes that postguard. Broad mass comparisons allow1e-12FPtolerance only
read: At most one missing-index real owner token conditioned at original history position; same-index identical retries idempotent, conflicting retries rejected. Reward correct+1,incorrect-1,abstain0 minus actual fee in .02,.12,.3,.6
